highlights.reason_zh: 它把单题准确率与轻微改写下的稳定性分开，公开样本可直接加入模型回归。
highlights.reason_en: It separates item accuracy from stability under small variations, with a public sample suitable for model regression.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开代码让团队能实测细粒度本地委派是否真的降低强模型成本，而不牺牲通过率。
highlights.reason_en: Public code lets teams test whether bounded local delegation cuts frontier-model cost without sacrificing pass rate.

highlights.reason_zh: MLX 版本把生成、嵌入和决策带到 M 系列 Mac，直接影响本地多模态应用的模型组合。
highlights.reason_en: MLX brings generation, embeddings and decisions to M-series Macs, changing the model mix for local multimodal apps.

highlights.reason_zh: ERNIE 5.5 Flash 从仅可调用 API 变为权重可下载，但未完成 preview 与厂商自测仍是关键限制。
highlights.reason_en: ERNIE 5.5 Flash moves from API-only access to downloadable weights, while its unfinished preview status and vendor-only results remain key limits.

highlights.reason_zh: 湿实验结合证据扩大了通用模型的科学能力边界，但专用模型依赖和未公开系统排除立即投入。
highlights.reason_en: Wet-lab binding evidence expands the scientific capability boundary, while specialist-model dependence and a private system rule out immediate investment.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 35/36 直接成功并完成阅读；可选 Meta 入口通过同一官方页面的独立请求恢复。主动覆盖模型/API、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文与其他非英语材料、小团队和重大综合新闻。HFE、AWS watermark、OpenAI 医疗配置和 Ling 独立结果存在日期或发布时间精度限制；多项性能结果尚待独立复现。 召回自检补录 6 个有明确处置价值的开放项目或研究，并对其余社区高热条目逐项记录过滤或范围外理由。 召回排序刷新后又补录 MemT-1.0-Pro，并保留其超大硬件与厂商自测边界。
coverage_en: Thirty-five of 36 fixed monitors succeeded directly and were fully read; the optional Meta monitor was recovered through a separate request to the same official page. Active discovery covered models and APIs, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese and other non-English sources, small teams and exceptional general news. HFE, AWS watermarking, OpenAI healthcare configurations and the Ling independent result have date or publication-time limits; several performance claims await independent reproduction. The recall audit recovered six open projects or studies with actionable dispositions and recorded explicit filtered or out-of-scope reasons for every other high-heat community item. A refreshed recall ranking also recovered MemT-1.0-Pro, preserving its extreme hardware and publisher-only evidence limits.
